title: FedPCD: Priority-Constrained Federated Aggregation
abstract: arXiv:2610.13508v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated learning (FL) seeks to optimize a shared global model from decentralized client data. While effective for average performance, this process can produce unfair performance across clients, particularly under statistically heterogeneous data distributions. Existing fairness-aware and multi-objective FL methods address this through client re-weighting, gradient correction, or common-descent formulations, but often change the global optimization direction or treat client objectives symmetrically. We propose FedPCD, a priority-constrained federated optimization framework that separates the global optimization objective from client protection. FedPCD preserves the conventional federated aggregate as the primary objective, while allowing only the minimum correction necessary to meet client performance constraints. translated_title: FedPCD：优先级约束的联邦聚合
translated_abstract: 联邦学习（FL）旨在从分散的客户端数据中优化共享的全局模型。虽然该方法对平均性能有效，但可能在客户端之间产生不公平的性能差异，尤其是在统计异构的数据分布下。现有的公平性感知和多目标联邦学习方法通过客户端重新加权、梯度校正或共同下降公式来解决这一问题，但往往会改变全局优化方向或对称地对待各客户端目标。我们提出了FedPCD，这是一种优先级约束的联邦优化框架，将全局优化目标与客户端保护分离开来。FedPCD保持传统的联邦聚合作为主要目标，同时仅允许满足客户端性能约束所需的最小校正。在异构联邦学习基准测试中，FedPCD始终优于最先进的基线方法，实现了最高的全局性能。
tldr: FedPCD提出了一种优先级约束的联邦学习优化框架，在保持传统联邦聚合为主要目标的同时，仅施加满足客户端性能约束所需的最小校正，将全局优化与客户端公平保护相分离，在异构数据场景下显著优于现有最先进方法。
en_tdlr: FedPCD is a priority-constrained federated optimization framework that preserves the conventional federated aggregate as the primary objective while applying only the minimal correction needed to meet client performance constraints, decoupling global optimization from client fairness protection and consistently outperforming state-of-the-art baselines on heterogeneous FL benchmarks.
